SELECT j.job_id , j.comp_id , u.company_name , j.title , j.field , CASE WHEN j.exp_year IS NULL THEN '경력 무관' WHEN j.exp_type = 'new' THEN '신입' WHEN j.exp_type = 'newCareer' THEN '신입·경력' WHEN j.exp_type = 'career' THEN '경력' ELSE '정보 없음' END as exp_year , j.edu , j.address , j.close_date , j.post_status , j.post_check , IF(b.bookmark_id IS NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS isScrapped FROM JOB_POSTING j JOIN USER_COMPANY u ON j.comp_id = u.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bookmark b ON j.job_id = b.job_id AND b.user_id = #{userIdx}
AND (j.exp_type = 'new' OR j.exp_type = 'newCareer')
AND (j.exp_type = 'career' OR j.exp_type = 'newCareer' OR j.exp_year IS NULL)
AND (
j.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{item}, '%') OR j.field LIKE CONCAT('%', #{item}, '%')
)
AND j.edu = '학력무관'
AND (j.edu = #{eduType} OR j.edu = '학력무관')
ORDER BY j.job_id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(address, '^[0-9\\s\\[\\],-]+', '')), ' ', 1) as city , SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(address, '^[0-9\\s\\[\\],-]+', '')), ' ', 2), ' ', -1) as district FROM JOB_POSTING WHERE post_status = 1 AND address IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.job_id , p.comp_id , c.company_name , p.title , p.field , p.task , p.emp_type , p.probation , p.exp_type , p.exp_year as raw_exp_year , CASE WHEN p.exp_year IS NULL THEN '경력 무관' WHEN p.exp_type = 'new' THEN '신입' WHEN p.exp_type = 'newCareer' THEN '신입·경력' ELSE concat(if(p.exp_type = 'career', '경력 ', ''), p.exp_year) END as exp_year , p.edu , p.salary , p.address , p.is_remote , p.mgr_name , p.mgr_phone , p.mgr_email , p.is_public , p.open_date , p.close_date , p.post_status , p.reg_date , p.post_check FROM job_posting p JOIN user_company c ON p.comp_id = c.user_id WHERE p.job_id = #{jobId}
SELECT resume_id , title , name_kor FROM resume WHERE user_id = #{userIdx} ORDER BY resume_id DESC
